name: branding-hand-drawn-bubbly-self-portrait-wordmark-with-eye-dots
title: Outlined bubbly hand-drawn SELF PORTRAIT wordmark, black-filled and yellow versions on a pink card and white tee
whatItIs: A white slide with corner labels and a wobbly hand-drawn wordmark 'self portrait' with irregular letters, black blob fills and dot eyes, then two photos: a pink business card held up to the camera and a white tee held over the face with the mark printed in yellow and black.
whatItMeans: Playful and raw; imperfect lettering feels like doodled graffiti for a street brand.
techniques: Draw irregular bubbly letters with black blobs.
Print in yellow on a tee.
Use a bright pink card stock.

vocabulary.definition: Solid black shapes inside outlined letters.
The same mark in different colours.
A product held toward the camera.
